ios.desc:
Picture this. It's 8:47 on a Tuesday. Your worksheet is on the kitchen table. You've been staring at problem 4 for ten minutes, and you don't quite remember how to integrate. Worse, every "homework helper" you've tried just hands over the answer, and you learn nothing except how to copy.

Knowable is different. Meet Milo, the next generation of AI tutoring.

Open the app, point the camera at the problem, and Milo starts paying attention. As you work through a problem, in an instant you can get a hint tailored to wherever you are in your process.

"What do you already know about the angles in a triangle?"
"You wrote 3x there. What does the x stand for?"
"Try reading the second sentence again. What's it actually asking you to find?"

Just the kind of small nudge a great teacher gives; the one that makes you go "oh, I see it now" and write the next line yourself.

WHAT MILO HELPS WITH

Working out a problem on paper, on your own, can be daunting and frustrating. That's where we hope to help. A nudge here, a hint there, visually grounded in the work you've done so far goes a long way in improving understanding and instilling confidence in your own problem solving skills.

FOR PARENTS AND TEACHERS

Trusting AI with the task of teaching your loved ones is a huge ask. We don't want to replace teachers or game metrics. We have one goal: to unblock you in your problem solving process when you're stuck. 

We don't ever save the desk view images on our servers. They're processed and deleted after the session is over. Voice recognition runs entirely on-device.

Teachers can follow along with their classes through a shared link. Parents decide what gets shared and what stays at home.

BUILT FOR REAL TESTS

Use "Test Prep" mode to drill dynamically generated problems on a loop, iteratively tuned to your exact level of understanding in the topic. All you need to do is upload your course materials and a short blurb about what to focus on, and what your goals are.

For free you get 1000 credits/month. If you want more, you can subscribe and get 10,000 credits/month. If that's still not enough, you can purchase additional credits in the app.

Open Knowable. Let yourself have the 24/7 patient tutor everyone deserves.

Privacy Statement at https://knowable.ca/privacy
